description: The developer’s server on THEIR Cloudflare account, deployed by Neblla (serverMode "own"; Cloudflare bills them, Neblla only the relay). The Cloudflare token is the ACCOUNT's or the PROJECT's connection, the topic "server" of Conexiones (neblla_projects "cloudflare_setup"), shared by their apps; it is pasted in the panel, never in the chat. action "set" { provider: "cloudflare" }: uses the token already connected (it needs Workers Scripts: Edit, and the account’s workers.dev subdomain on); cloudflare_not_connected with the panel's link when there is none. Then switches the app to "own" and deploys the box — the same room.js runner as Neblla’s cloud; saving a server/ file redeploys it. "remove": takes the Worker off their account (the token stays connected for the other apps; the app stays "own": `npx @neblla/server` with the server key still serves it). The token is entered in the panel, never in the call. The actions that only look (status) are in neblla_byos_read.
name: neblla_byos
